desc:
Realistic motocross physics on Roblox. Pick a bike, pick a track and ride.

- 3 classes: MX1 (450 four-stroke), MX2 (250 four-stroke) and MX2-2T (125 two-stroke), each with its own engine and handling.
- 5 tracks: Farm14, Walnut, Desert Ridge MX, Mouse Motopark and Canyon Raceway.
- Detailed riding: throttle, clutch, gears, front and rear brakes, and body position. Lean and shift your weight to control the bike.
- 3 camera views: static onboard, dynamic onboard and chase.
- Full control setup: rebind every control for gamepad or keyboard, with conflict warnings. Your settings are saved.
- Lap times, best laps, replays and photo mode.

This first version is solo Testing: ride, practise and chase your best lap. More is coming in updates.

Best with a gamepad.
